preconditions.description: The input sequence length n must be between 2 and 30000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(x, int) and -10**8 <= x <= 10**8 for x in sequence)
preconditions.description: All elements in the sequence must be distinct integers within the range [-10^8, 10^8].
All elements in the sequence must be distinct.

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() == 'No solution' or (len(progression1) >= 1 and len(progression2) >= 1 and set(progression1).isdisjoint(set(progression2)) and set(progression1).union(set(progression2)) == set(sequence))
postconditions.description: If a solution exists, stdout must contain exactly two non-empty arithmetic progressions that partition the input sequence without changing the relative order of elements. If no solution exists, stdout must be 'No solution'.

postconditions.expression: all(len(progression) >= 1 for progression in [progression1, progression2]) if stdout.strip() != 'No solution' else True
postconditions.description: Each progression must contain at least one element if a solution exists.

postconditions.expression: all(is_arithmetic(progression) for progression in [progression1, progression2]) if stdout.strip() != 'No solution' else True
postconditions.description: Each progression must be an arithmetic progression (including sequences of length 1 or 2).

postconditions.expression: all(sequence[i] == progression1[j] or sequence[i] == progression2[j] for i, j in enumerate(zip(range(len(sequence)), range(len(progression1) + len(progression2))))) if stdout.strip() != 'No solution' else True
postconditions.description: The union of the two progressions must exactly match the input sequence in order.
